text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing acute diarrhea; to help me determine the cause, please tell me how many times you have had loose stools in the last 24 hours and if you have noticed any blood or mucus in them.

speaker: Patient
text: 58-year-old female. The patient has been treated for community-acquired pneumonia with levofloxacin on the medical floor. She reports developing watery diarrhea with at least 9 episodes within the last two days, accompanied by lower abdominal discomfort and cramping.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Antibiotic-associated diarrhea, likely Clostridioides difficile infection (C. diff), given the recent use of levofloxacin for community-acquired pneumonia, onset of watery diarrhea (≥9 episodes/24h), and lower abdominal cramping.
